summary: Initializes a session configuration structure to defaults: copies the default application-directory string into the global buffer byte_5EA438 three times via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sets the field at this+0x10 to the literal 7. Unconditional; no guard branches.

operations.description: First copy of the default directory string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438).
Second copy of the default directory string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438).
Set the field at this+0x10 to the literal 7 (session config flag/counter default).
Third copy of the default directory string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438), whose result becomes the return value.
Return the result of the final StringCopyWithBufferRealloc call.

unresolved: The meaning of the value 7 at this+0x10 and the purpose of the repeated buffer copy are not evidenced here.
Reason the copy is performed three times rather than once is unresolved.
